Oba · Alanyum Mall · Alanya

Flower bouquets in Alanya

We cut and wrap in Oba. If you are in a hotel, WhatsApp is faster than walking in: hotel name, room, time, a rough budget. We send a photo before the courier leaves.

Online shop: balconyflowers.com — pay by card, see stock, place the order there.

Shop every day 08:30–19:30. Door delivery 10:30–18:00. Inside Alanya the drop is free. Address: Oba, Çalış sitesi, Eczacılar Cd. D:A Blok, 07460 Alanya. Phone 0552 379 83 73.

How to order

Three ways, none of them a call centre script.

  1. WhatsApp. Write where it should go and when. We reply with a photo from the bench. You say yes, then we pack.
  2. Card and catalogue. Pay on balconyflowers.com. We still confirm the hour for a fresh bouquet.
  3. Walk in. Custom work is the Oba shop. Ready bunches sit in the Alanyum Mall corner.

WhatsApp

Delivery

Oba, Tosmur and Cikcilli are the easy same-day run. Kestel is close to that rhythm. Mahmutlar, Konaklı, Kargıcak and Payallar: we go, but lock the hour first. After 17:00 a new same-day run is often too tight.

We do not promise a twenty-minute drop to every beach hotel. Write the hotel name, not only “Alanya centre”.

Shops

The workshop is in Oba, Çalış sitesi, Eczacılar Caddesi, block A. That is where we build what you asked for. Inside Alanyum AVM there is a smaller corner — Balcony Corner — for a bunch you can take at once.

Cash or card in the shop. Online card payments stay on balconyflowers.com.

Questions people actually ask

Can you leave it at reception?

Yes. Write the hotel and the room. If the guest should not see the sender, say that too. We still send you the photo first.

Do you take cards?

In the shop, yes. For a delivery paid in advance, use balconyflowers.com. WhatsApp orders can also be settled on delivery when we agree that.

Will it look like the website photo?

Same idea, that morning’s stems. Colour and paper shift. If a red rose is what you need, say so; if “something cheerful” is enough, we use what is fresh.

English, German, Russian — is that alright?

WhatsApp in those languages is fine. Keep the hotel, room and time in the first message. The full Turkish site has more neighbourhood detail; this page is the practical desk.
